name: Golden Visa -- Investor Residence Permit (Real Estate)

requirement_groups.name: Real estate in Attica, Thessaloniki area, Mykonos, Santorini, and islands with over 3,100 inhabitants

requirements.blocker_text: Requires real estate acquisition (or long-term lease with total rent equal to the required amount) of at least EUR 800,000, with a minimum main living area of 120 sqm for built properties.

requirement_groups.name: Real estate in the rest of Greece

requirements.blocker_text: Requires real estate acquisition (or long-term lease with total rent equal to the required amount) of at least EUR 400,000 outside the designated high-demand zones, with a minimum main living area of 120 sqm for built properties.

requirement_groups.name: Conversion of non-residential (e.g. industrial) or preservable/heritage buildings to residential use

requirements.blocker_text: Requires acquisition of at least EUR 250,000, with the change of use to residential completed after 5 April 2024 (entry into force of Article 64 of Law 5100/2024) and before the application is filed. For former industrial buildings, no industrial activity for the preceding 5+ years must be documented.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase and convert a qualifying property before applying.

evidence_required.document: Notarial certificate of the property transfer deed

outcome.duration_length: 5 years, renewable indefinitely while the qualifying investment is retained

sources.title: National Registry of Administrative Public Services (mitos.gov.gr) -- Golden Visa (change of use), EUR 250,000, 5-year validity, no work rights, confirmed directly at tier-1
Watson Farley & Williams -- Understanding the new Golden Visa Law No. 5100/2024 (zone thresholds: EUR 800,000 / 400,000 / 250,000, effective 1 September 2024)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Greece's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT: the EUR 250,000 change-of-use figure, the 5-year permit duration, the no-employment-rights rule, and the automatic-revocation-on-resale rule are all confirmed directly at tier-1 (mitos.gov.gr). However, the main EUR 800,000/EUR 400,000 zone-tiered real-estate thresholds -- the categories most investors actually use -- are only independently confirmed via a tier-3 international law firm source (Watson Farley & Williams) describing Law 5100/2024; migration.gov.gr's own 'golden visa' and 'dieukrinistika-golden-visa' (clarifying documents) pages reference these figures only via linked PDFs that could not be read inline in this pass. leads_to_pr left false / pr_after_months null: sources describe the investor permit itself as indefinitely renewable (a de facto permanent status) rather than converting into a separate PR category -- this is modelled as switchable directly to naturalisation once Greece's general residence-duration requirements are met, not asserted as a confirmed fast-track. citizenship_after_months left null since the applicable naturalisation track (ordinary 7-year, see gr_naturalisation) is what would apply and no investor-specific citizenship shortcut was found in sources reviewed.
